body.p: Common questions and answers about using the application.

section.title: General Questions

p.b: Q: What file formats are supported?

section.p: A: The application supports DITA XML, HTML, Markdown, and plain text.

p.b: Q: Is there a mobile version?

section.p: A: Currently, the application is available for desktop platforms only.
A: Yes, all features work offline except cloud synchronization.

section.title: Technical Questions

p.b: Q: How do I back up my documents?

section.p: A: Use File → Export to create backups in various formats.

p.b: Q: Can I customize keyboard shortcuts?

section.p: A: Yes, go to Tools → Preferences → Keyboard to customize shortcuts.

p.b: Q: How do I report bugs?

section.p: A: Use Help → Report Issue to submit bug reports.
